messages.content: You are an expert tenant screening analyst for South African real estate. Analyze applications objectively and return ONLY valid JSON. Be thorough but fair. Consider local context (employment stability, rental market conditions, typical documentation).

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO tenant_screening_results (
  application_id,
  applicant_name,
  completeness_score,
  risk_level,
  risk_score,
  affordability_ratio,
  affordability_status,
  red_flags,
  positive_indicators,
  recommended_verifications,
  document_issues,
  summary,
  recommendation,
  confidence
) VALUES (
  {{ $json.application_id ? "'" + $json.application_id + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.applicant_name }}',
  {{ $json.completeness_score }},
  '{{ $json.risk_level }}',
  {{ $json.risk_score }},
  {{ $json.affordability_ratio }},
  '{{ $json.affordability_status }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.red_flags) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.positive_indicators) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.recommended_verifications) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.document_issues) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.summary.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.recommendation }}',
  {{ $json.confidence }}
) RETURNING id;

body.subject: ðŸš¨ HIGH RISK: Tenant Application Requires Urgent Review - {{ $json.applicant_name }}

parameters.responseBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  success: true,
  screening_complete: true,
  applicant_name: $json.applicant_name,
  risk_level: $json.risk_level,
  risk_score: $json.risk_score,
  completeness_score: $json.completeness_score,
  affordability_status: $json.affordability_status,
  affordability_ratio: $json.affordability_ratio,
  red_flags_count: $json.red_flags.length,
  positive_indicators: $json.positive_indicators,
  recommended_verifications: $json.recommended_verifications,
  summary: $json.summary,
  recommendation: $json.recommendation,
  confidence: $json.confidence,
  requires_urgent_review: $json.requires_urgent_review,
  message: $json.risk_level === 'high' 
    ? 'High risk application flagged for urgent review' 
    : 'Screening complete - ready for agent review'
}, null, 2) }}
